'''Antonio Vigliotti''' (also published as '''Tony Vigliotti''') is a Star Wars CCG player from the Syracuse, New York area who finished 19th, 8 (−9), 4–4 at [[1999 Battle of Midway]] on 7 August 1999, according to Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d5">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ binghamton-new-york-8-7-99], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at [[2000 Coruscant Civil War]] on 4 November 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HBX]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1427">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00d1427/ coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00d1427/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
